title: Yellowfin Peruvian Bulgur Wheat Ceviche Clasico
description: A refreshing and protein rich Peruvian dish featuring yellowfin tuna, bulgur wheat, and a zesty citrus marinade, served in a copper mug.
instructions: Rinse the bulgur wheat and soak it in water for 30 minutes.
Drain and rinse the bulgur wheat, then set it aside to dry.
Cut the yellowfin tuna into small cubes and place it in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the lime juice, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt.
Pour the citrus marinade over the tuna and mix well to coat.
Stir in the mixed citrus segments, red onion, and cilantro.
To assemble the dish, place a scoop of the bulgur wheat in the bottom of a copper mug.
Add a portion of the tuna mixture on top of the bulgur wheat.
Serve the ceviche clasico with toasted bread on the side.
Garnish with additional cilantro and citrus segments if desired.
